source: User-supplied Ferrer et al. 2008 PDFs, Fig. 4 p.215 and Fig.5 p.216

processing.name: canny
processing.scientific_limit: Edges are not equal to original incisions

observations: Original and CLAHE preserve approximately the same apparent sign candidates; CLAHE increases visibility of corrosion, scratches and deformation too.
Strongly textured and partly fused region is not suitable for automatic extraction of reliable glyph identities.
Published editorial drawing and photograph should be contrasted at matched local regions before any character-level decision.
next_actions: Two independent blind visual annotations of candidate strokes on unaltered image
Registration of verified pairwise matching photo/drawing sign ROIs
Score disagreement and missing-stroke uncertainty; reject guesses without discriminating visible features
Acquire additional oblique lighting or multispectral photos from object custodian if published photo remains ambiguous
